messages:
katie: Quick sync — we want to announce v0.9 tomorrow. Need final changelog and canonical docs links by EOD today so marketing can lock the blog + social schedule. Also need rollout timing for coordination with release.
ben: On changelog now. I can drop a draft in here by 15:00 PT. Will include the perf numbers and the API compatibility notes.
aj: Docs staging build is green. Staging link: https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/staging/v0.9/ — I can promote to prod at 10:30 PT tomorrow if that works.
maria: Webinar landing page is ready: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar-v0-9 — want to confirm the headline/copy before we embed it in the blog. Also want UTMs for lead routing.
sam: Release plan we propose: canary 5% at 09:00 PT -> monitor 2h -> ramp to 25% -> 100% by 24h if key SLOs look good. We should set marketing embargo to lift at 11:00 PT so we don't flood with alerts during early canary.
katie: Marketing target publish: 11:15 PT (blog + tweet thread + LinkedIn). Can we get docs live by 10:45 so links in the blog point to prod?
aj: I’ll promote at 10:30 PT and ping here with the prod URL when finished. I'll also add the canonical changelog link.
ben: Draft changelog (will refine):
```
- Improved KV cache eviction logic -> reduces repeated prefix recomputation
- ~30% median token generation latency improvement on long-context workloads
- New quantized model variant (q4_x2) with 20–40% cost reduction in common batch scenarios
- Minor API header change: `X-Model-Version` now required for pinned inference (backward compatible)
- Bugfix: streaming reconnect on transient gRPC resets
```
Link to full draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/blob/main/v0.9.md
katie: Ben — can you add a one-line marketing-friendly stat (e.g., "20–40% lower token cost on typical LLM batch workloads") at top of changelog so we can use it in the hero?
ben: Yup adding that now. Also flagging the API header change as "opt-in" for this release and adding migration notes.
sam: I'll post the final rollout timeline to #release-war-room 30m before deploy and coordinate on-call. We should also set a canary alert: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency regression > 15% triggers rollback.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy started -> promoting https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/staging/v0.9/ to prod at 2026-01-22T10:30:00Z
aj: Prod docs are live: https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/v0.9/ — changelog anchor added at /v0.9/changelog
maria: For inbound routing: will append utm_campaign=v0_9_launch and utm_source=blog to blog/webinar links. I'll create a HubSpot workflow to route submissions to SDR queue `sdr_v2` and notify AE team.
katie: Perfect. Final checklist for me: blog draft w/ hero stat, screenshots (from eng), docs link, webinar CTA with UTMs, publish at 11:15 PT. Ben — please paste final changelog link here when ready.
ben: Final changelog pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/blob/main/v0.9.md#summary — added the hero stat and migration note. ping me if copy needs technical edits.
katie: Thanks everyone — will schedule the blog + socials and confirm once published. If anything changes to the rollout timing, @sam please update here so marketing can hold or go-live. :thumbsup:
